value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value.name: Checklist of expedited-review requirements, published on the City's website

required_documents.notes: Per Sanger Municipal Code Section 14-93(b)(1)-(2): the community development department develops a checklist of all requirements, published on the city's internet website; applicant may submit by personal, mailed, or electronic submittal. The code text itself does not itemize further documents beyond this checklist.

value: For a small residential rooftop solar energy system eligible for expedited review, only one inspection shall be required, which shall be done in a timely manner
If a small residential rooftop solar energy system fails inspection, a subsequent inspection is authorized

timeline_days.notes: Sanger Municipal Code Section 14-93(b)(6) states the building official shall 'administratively approve' a complete application but does not state an explicit day-count turnaround figure.

value.program_or_pathway: Small Residential Rooftop Solar Energy System expedited permitting (Sanger Municipal Code Section 14-93)
other_conditions: System must be installed on a single- or duplex-family dwelling
Solar panel/module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height as defined by the City of Sanger
